parsed.post: Massive improvement! Dropped from 1.0235 to 0.9891. It seems reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 on the DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=48 base is highly effective. Next, I'll test increasing ASPECT_RATIO back to 64 with this optimized LR to see if the resolution/context boost works better with slower, more stable optimization.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 while maintaining the improved MATRIX_LR of 0.04 to see if higher resolution context combined with stable learning rates yields further gains.
